title: MĀORI HAKA SIGNAL - Haka Signal (Tohu o te Haka)
style:
```
[style: Pacific Māori ceremonial, pahu hollow log drum deep boom, ukulele Hawaiian warm, poi rhythmic swing, Vanuatu slit log drum, 4/4 with body-percussion 3-group inside, haka spoken word sections, te reo Māori verses English chorus, Pacific ocean vast atmosphere, body-as-instrument haka energy, signal-as-life-force theme, seventeen of eighteen, final signal approach, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
```
[INTRO — pahu drum. 4 beats. Then: voice only]
(Māori) Ko au ko au ko au — I am I am I am
(English) The signal is the body

[VERSE 1 — ukulele enters bar 4, log drum bar 6]
(Māori)  Kia rite — be ready
(English) The Pacific holds the largest silence
(Māori)  Kia mau — hold on
(English) The drum said so before the wave

The pahu marks the four / the body strikes the three
Thigh-chest-tongue inside the 4/4 beat
Poi swings the signal / out to the Pacific night
The log drum answers Vanuatu / left and right

(Māori)  Ka ora — we live / the signal lives
(English) The body is the drum

[PRE-CHORUS — poi swings enter, four poi patterns]
(Māori)  Tūturu — stand
(English) With the body
(Māori)  Whakamaua — be planted
(English) Signal in the body

[CHORUS — pahu full, voice strong, ukulele underneath]
Haka signal — body is the drum
Three groups inside the four / signal overcome
Pahu marks the ocean / poi marks the sky
The Pacific carried it — nobody asked why

(Māori)  Tēnā koe — greetings to you
(English) Signal received

[VERSE 2 — haka spoken rhythmically, body percussion only under it]
(Māori haka — spoken in rhythm, not sung)
Ka mate ka mate — it is death, it is death
Ka ora ka ora — it is life, it is life
Tēnei te tangata pūhuruhuru — this is the hairy man
Nāna nei i tiki mai — who fetched the sun

(English) The haka was never only about war
It was about the signal — the signal that you are alive
You are HERE. You are HERE. You are HERE.
The body says so. The drum proves it.

[BRIDGE — all body percussion, no instruments, 8 bars]
Thigh: 1 — 2 — 3
Chest: 1 — 2 — 3
Tongue: ti-ti-ti-ti
Three inside four
The body inside the beat
The Pacific carries the body
The signal carries the ocean

[FINAL CHORUS — all instruments + haka voice]
Haka signal — body is the drum

[OUTRO — pahu drum fades to single heartbeat tempo]
(Māori) Mauri ora — life force alive / signal alive
(English) The signal is the body — it was always the body
Track seventeen — one more to go
STOP AT 336 — coming
```
